# A call passed as an argument is evaluated after the whole request has been
# parsed, so a malformed value anywhere in the call never reaches the receiver;
# its result keeps the type the call returned, a nil concrete error is not an
# error, an error that is a struct always is, and a package function may be
# named like a generated local or a request value.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "GET /pair/{left}/{right} Pair(Load(left), right)"}}{{with .Err}}failed: {{.}}{{else}}{{.Result}}{{end}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /lookup Show(Find())"}}{{with .Err}}failed: {{.}}{{else}}{{.Result}}{{end}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /shadow Show(result0())"}}{{with .Err}}failed: {{.}}{{else}}{{.Result}}{{end}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /context ShowWithContext(ctx(), ctx)"}}{{with .Err}}failed: {{.}}{{else}}{{.Result}}{{end}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /parsed/{right} Pair(rightParsed(), right)"}}{{with .Err}}failed: {{.}}{{else}}{{.Result}}{{end}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /value Show(Value())"}}{{with .Err}}failed: {{.}}{{else}}{{.Result}}{{end}}{{end}}
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

type Server struct{ loads *int }

type LookupError struct{ Key string }

func (e *LookupError) Error() string { return "lookup " + e.Key }

func (s Server) Load(n int) int {
	*s.loads++
	return n * 10
}

func (Server) Pair(a, b int) string { return fmt.Sprint("pair ", a, " ", b) }

// Find returns a nil *LookupError: the call succeeded.
func (Server) Find() (int, *LookupError) { return 7, nil }

func (Server) Show(n int) string { return fmt.Sprint("show ", n) }

func result0() int { return 42 }

// ctx and rightParsed are named like locals the handler declares for the
// request context and for a parsed path value.
func ctx() int { return 5 }

func rightParsed() int { return 3 }

func (Server) ShowWithContext(n int, ctx context.Context) string {
	return fmt.Sprint("context ", n, " ", ctx != nil)
}

// ValueError is an error that is a struct: any value of it is an error.
type ValueError struct{}

func (ValueError) Error() string { return "value error" }

func (Server) Value() (int, ValueError) { return 1, ValueError{} }
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestEvaluationOrder(t *testing.T) {
	var loads int
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{loads: &loads})

	for _, tt := range []struct {
		target    string
		wantCode  int
		wantBody  string
		wantLoads int
	}{
		{"/pair/1/2", http.StatusOK, "pair 10 2", 1},
		{"/pair/1/bad", http.StatusBadRequest, "failed: ", 0},
		{"/pair/bad/2", http.StatusBadRequest, "failed: ", 0},
		{"/lookup", http.StatusOK, "show 7", 0},
		{"/context", http.StatusOK, "context 5 true", 0},
		{"/parsed/4", http.StatusOK, "pair 3 4", 0},
		{"/parsed/bad", http.StatusBadRequest, "failed: ", 0},
		{"/value", http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed: value error", 0},
		{"/shadow", http.StatusOK, "show 42", 0},
	} {
		loads = 0
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, tt.target, nil))
		if rec.Code != tt.wantCode {
			t.Errorf("GET %s status = %d, want %d (body %q)", tt.target, rec.Code, tt.wantCode, rec.Body.String())
		}
		if !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), tt.wantBody) {
			t.Errorf("GET %s body = %q, want it to contain %q", tt.target, rec.Body.String(), tt.wantBody)
		}
		if loads != tt.wantLoads {
			t.Errorf("GET %s called Load %d times, want %d", tt.target, loads, tt.wantLoads)
		}
	}
}
